title.en: Self play works so well in chess, go, and poker because those games are two-player zero-sum. That simplifies a lot of problems. The real world is messier, which

note.en: Interview from his FAIR years on beating top poker players and on why spending compute at inference time pays off.
note.zh: 他在 FAIR 期间的访谈，谈击败顶尖扑克选手的经历，以及在推理阶段投入算力为何有效。

title.en: The bot Cicero can collaborate, scheme and build trust with humans. What does this mean for the next frontier of AI? With Noam Brown, Research Scientist at Meta
title.zh: The bot Cicero can collaborate, scheme and build trust with humans. What does this mean for the next frontier of AI? With Noam Brown, Research Scientist at Meta

note.en: Interview on Cicero, the Diplomacy agent that negotiates in natural language, recorded while Brown was at Meta.
note.zh: 关于用自然语言谈判的 Diplomacy 智能体 Cicero 的访谈，录制于 Brown 还在 Meta 时期。

title.en: Interview with Noam Brown from Meta
title.zh: Interview with Noam Brown from Meta

note.en: Interview with the Diplomacy community about how CICERO was built, given shortly after the system was published.
note.zh: 系统发布后不久，他面向外交棋玩家社区讲述 CICERO 的构建过程。

title.en: Abstracting Imperfect Information Away from Two-Player Zero-Sum Games
title.zh: Abstracting Imperfect Information Away from Two-Player Zero-Sum Games

note.en: Shows two-player zero-sum imperfect-information games can be reduced to perfect-information ones via public policy announcement; Brown is senior author.
note.zh: 证明两人零和不完美信息博弈可通过公开策略化归为完美信息博弈，Brown 为通讯作者。

title.en: #344 – Noam Brown: AI vs Humans in Poker and Games of Strategic Negotiation
title.zh: #344 – Noam Brown: AI vs Humans in Poker and Games of Strategic Negotiation

note.en: Long-form Lex Fridman interview on building AI that beats humans at no-limit poker and at strategic negotiation.
note.zh: 在 Lex Fridman 播客的长篇访谈，谈如何构建在无限注扑克与策略性谈判中击败人类的 AI。

title.en: Mastering the Game of No-Press Diplomacy via Human-Regularized Reinforcement Learning and Planning
title.zh: Mastering the Game of No-Press Diplomacy via Human-Regularized Reinforcement Learning and Planning

note.en: Human-regularized RL and planning that reaches top human level at no-press Diplomacy; Brown is senior author.
note.zh: 用人类正则化的强化学习与规划，在无通信 Diplomacy 中达到顶尖人类水平，Brown 为通讯作者。

title.en: Human-AI Coordination via Human-Regularized Search and Learning
title.zh: Human-AI Coordination via Human-Regularized Search and Learning

note.en: Applies piKL-style human regularization to cooperative human-AI play; Brown is senior author.
note.zh: 把 piKL 式的人类正则化用于人机协作场景，Brown 为通讯作者。

title.en: A Unified Approach to Reinforcement Learning, Quantal Response Equilibria, and Two-Player Zero-Sum Games
title.zh: A Unified Approach to Reinforcement Learning, Quantal Response Equilibria, and Two-Player Zero-Sum Games

note.en: Introduces magnetic mirror descent, linking RL, quantal response equilibria and two-player zero-sum solving; Brown is a co-author.
note.zh: 提出磁性镜像下降，把强化学习、量子响应均衡与两人零和求解统一起来，Brown 为共同作者。

title.en: Equilibrium Finding in Normal-Form Games Via Greedy Regret Minimization
title.zh: Equilibrium Finding in Normal-Form Games Via Greedy Regret Minimization

note.en: Regret-minimization variant that greedily reweights iterates for faster equilibrium finding in normal-form games; Brown is senior author.
note.zh: 在标准型博弈中按遗憾贪心加权迭代以加快均衡求解的遗憾最小化变体，Brown 为通讯作者。

title.en: Modeling Strong and Human-Like Gameplay with KL-Regularized Search
title.zh: Modeling Strong and Human-Like Gameplay with KL-Regularized Search

note.en: piKL, the KL-regularized search method for strong but human-like policies that later underpinned Cicero; Brown is senior author.
note.zh: 提出 piKL 这一 KL 正则化搜索方法，可得到强而类人的策略，后来支撑了 Cicero，Brown 为通讯作者。

title.en: No-Press Diplomacy from Scratch
title.zh: No-Press Diplomacy from Scratch

note.en: Trains a no-press Diplomacy agent without human data despite an action space of over 10^20; Brown is senior author.
note.zh: 在动作空间超过 10^20 的情况下不依赖人类数据从零训练无通信 Diplomacy 智能体，Brown 为通讯作者。

title.en: Scalable Online Planning via Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning
title.zh: Scalable Online Planning via Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning

note.en: Replaces expensive lookahead search with reinforcement learning fine-tuning at execution time; Brown is senior author.
note.zh: 在线规划中用执行时的强化学习微调替代昂贵的前瞻搜索，Brown 为通讯作者。

title.en: Learned Belief Search: Efficiently Improving Policies in Partially Observable Settings
title.zh: Learned Belief Search: Efficiently Improving Policies in Partially Observable Settings

note.en: Cheaper approximation to belief-based search in partially observable settings; Brown is a co-author.
note.zh: 在部分可观测环境中对基于信念的搜索给出更廉价的近似，Brown 为共同作者。

title.en: Safe Search for Stackelberg Equilibria in Extensive-Form Games
title.zh: Safe Search for Stackelberg Equilibria in Extensive-Form Games

posts.source: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on…

note.en: With Chun Kai Ling, Brown extends the search techniques behind Libratus/Pluribus to Stackelberg equilibria, letting a leader improve a precomputed blueprint strategy online without ever performing worse than it.
note.zh: Brown与Chun Kai Ling合作，将Libratus/Pluribus背后的搜索技术扩展到Stackelberg均衡问题，使先行者能够在线改进预先计算好的蓝图策略，且效果绝不劣于原策略。

title.en: Off-Belief Learning
title.zh: Off-Belief Learning

note.en: Off-belief learning, a rule that strips arbitrary self-play conventions so agents coordinate with unseen partners; Brown is a co-author.
note.zh: 提出 off-belief learning，去除自博弈中形成的任意约定，使智能体能与陌生伙伴协作，Brown 为共同作者。

title.en: Human-Level Performance in No-Press Diplomacy via Equilibrium Search
title.zh: Human-Level Performance in No-Press Diplomacy via Equilibrium Search

note.en: First agent to reach human level at no-press Diplomacy, using equilibrium search; Brown is senior author.
note.zh: 首个借助均衡搜索在无通信 Diplomacy 中达到人类水平的智能体，Brown 为通讯作者。

title.en: Combining Deep Reinforcement Learning and Search for Imperfect-Information Games
title.zh: Combining Deep Reinforcement Learning and Search for Imperfect-Information Games

note.en: ReBeL, Brown's algorithm unifying deep RL with search for imperfect-information games and a direct precursor to his later reasoning work.
note.zh: ReBeL 算法把深度强化学习与搜索统一用于不完美信息博弈，是 Brown 后来推理工作的直接前身。

title.en: Unlocking the Potential of Deep Counterfactual Value Networks
title.zh: Unlocking the Potential of Deep Counterfactual Value Networks

note.en: Improvements to deep counterfactual value networks for depth-limited poker search; Brown is a co-author.
note.zh: 改进用于有限深度扑克搜索的深度反事实价值网络，Brown 为共同作者。

title.en: DREAM: Deep Regret minimization with Advantage baselines and Model-free learning
title.zh: DREAM: Deep Regret minimization with Advantage baselines and Model-free learning

note.en: DREAM, a model-free deep regret minimization algorithm for multi-agent imperfect-information games; Brown is senior author.
note.zh: DREAM 算法，面向多智能体不完美信息博弈的无模型深度遗憾最小化方法，Brown 为通讯作者。

title.en: Improving Policies via Search in Cooperative Partially Observable Games
title.zh: Improving Policies via Search in Cooperative Partially Observable Games

note.en: Brings search to cooperative partially observable games such as Hanabi; Brown is senior author.
note.zh: 把搜索引入 Hanabi 这类合作型部分可观测博弈，Brown 为通讯作者。

title.en: Stable-Predictive Optimistic Counterfactual Regret Minimization
title.zh: Stable-Predictive Optimistic Counterfactual Regret Minimization

note.en: First CFR variant with a near-optimal convergence rate; Brown is a co-author.
note.zh: 首个具备近最优收敛速率的 CFR 变体，Brown 为共同作者。

title.en: Deep Counterfactual Regret Minimization
title.zh: Deep Counterfactual Regret Minimization

note.en: Deep CFR, the neural version of counterfactual regret minimization that removed the need for hand-crafted abstractions; Brown is first author.
note.zh: Deep CFR 用神经网络实现反事实遗憾最小化，摆脱了人工抽象设计，Brown 为第一作者。

title.en: Solving Imperfect-Information Games via Discounted Regret Minimization
title.zh: Solving Imperfect-Information Games via Discounted Regret Minimization

note.en: Discounted CFR, which sharply speeds up equilibrium finding and was used in the Pluribus poker bot; Brown is first author.
note.zh: 折扣式 CFR 大幅加快均衡求解，并被扑克 AI Pluribus 采用，Brown 为第一作者。

title.en: Depth-Limited Solving for Imperfect-Information Games
title.zh: Depth-Limited Solving for Imperfect-Information Games

note.en: Depth-limited search for imperfect-information games, the technique that let a laptop-scale poker bot beat professionals; Brown is first author.
note.zh: 面向不完美信息博弈的有限深度搜索，使笔记本级扑克 AI 也能击败职业选手，Brown 为第一作者。

title.en: Safe and Nested Subgame Solving for Imperfect-Information Games
title.zh: Safe and Nested Subgame Solving for Imperfect-Information Games

note.en: Safe and nested subgame solving, the core technique behind Libratus, the first bot to beat top humans at heads-up no-limit poker; Brown is first author.
note.zh: 安全嵌套子博弈求解，是首个在单挑无限注扑克中击败顶尖人类的 Libratus 的核心技术，Brown 为第一作者。

title.en: Reduced Space and Faster Convergence in Imperfect-Information Games via Regret-Based Pruning
title.zh: Reduced Space and Faster Convergence in Imperfect-Information Games via Regret-Based Pruning

note.en: Regret-based pruning, which cuts the memory and time cost of CFR in large imperfect-information games; Brown is first author.
note.zh: 基于遗憾的剪枝方法，降低 CFR 在大规模不完美信息博弈中的内存与时间开销，Brown 为第一作者。

title.en: AI That Knows It's Being Tested — Noam Brown on Harder Alignment Evals
title.zh: AI That Knows It's Being Tested — Noam Brown on Harder Alignment Evals

body.en: Brown discusses the problem of AI models recognizing when they are being evaluated, and argues for harder, more robust alignment evals.
body.zh: 布朗探讨了AI模型能够识别自身正被测试的问题，并主张设计更严格、更稳健的对齐评测。

title.en: OpenAI's Noam Brown reveals how AI agents solved a Millennium Prize Problem in 88 hours
title.zh: OpenAI's Noam Brown reveals how AI agents solved a Millennium Prize Problem in 88 hours

body.en: Noam Brown detailed how a swarm of roughly 10,000 OpenAI agents worked 88 hours to claim a solution to the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize problem, while cautioning that multi-agent coordination accounted for less than 10% of the breakthrough versus human research judgment.
body.zh: 诺姆·布朗披露OpenAI约1万个智能体协同工作88小时，声称解决了纳维-斯托克斯千禧年大奖难题，但他也提醒多智能体协作仅贡献了不到10%的突破，其余靠人类的研究判断力。

title.en: OpenAI's Noam Brown Says Even Air-Gapped Systems May Not Contain Advanced AI
title.zh: OpenAI's Noam Brown Says Even Air-Gapped Systems May Not Contain Advanced AI

body.en: Brown warned that even air-gapped systems may not be enough to contain sufficiently advanced AI.
body.zh: 布朗警告称，即使是物理隔离的系统，也未必能够遏制足够先进的AI。

title.en: OpenAI's Noam Brown Says Recursive AI Improvement Faces a 3x Speed Limit — Not an Overnight Explosion
title.zh: OpenAI's Noam Brown Says Recursive AI Improvement Faces a 3x Speed Limit — Not an Overnight Explosion

body.en: Noam Brown said recursive AI self-improvement faces roughly a 3x speed limit rather than an overnight explosion.
body.zh: Noam Brown表示，递归式AI自我改进面临约3倍的速度上限，而非一夜爆发式提升。

title.en: OpenAI’s ‘Top Priority’ for AI Agents is Automating AI Research, Says Noam Brown
title.zh: OpenAI’s ‘Top Priority’ for AI Agents is Automating AI Research, Says Noam Brown

body.en: Noam Brown said automating AI research is OpenAI's top priority for AI agents, per The Information.
body.zh: 据The Information报道，诺姆·布朗表示让AI代理实现AI研究自动化是OpenAI当前的首要任务。
